### 1. RTU products
Guojin He pioneered the concept of a ready-to-use (RTU) satellite remote-sensing product archive and led the development of a rapid processing system for multi-source satellite RTU products. RTU products feature radiometric normalization, geometric standardization, and a tiled grid structure, allowing direct use in subsequent analysis and applications.
![Ready-to-use (RTU) remote-sensing product archive](image-10.png)

![Abbreviations of RTU product names](https://kns.cnki.net/nzkhtml/resource/CJFD/KXGZ202004002/images/KXGZ202004002_00900.jpg "Abbreviations of RTU product names")

#### (4) Integrated surface reflectance retrieval
We developed an **integrated** surface reflectance retrieval method using coupled atmospheric, terrain, and BRDF correction to address joint processing of large-scale, long-term, multi-source satellite imagery across spatial, temporal, and spectral dimensions.
![Integrated surface reflectance retrieval](image.png)
